---
title: "Analysis"
---

This page shows how the results of a script can be rendered. The chunks below
are not run (`eval: false` is set in `_quarto.yml`), so the site builds without
any data. Turn evaluation on for a page with `execute: eval: true` in its
header once the data is available, and only if the output is safe to publish.

## Load the processed data

```{r}
#| label: load-processed
processed <- readRDS(file = fs::path("data", "processed", "my_data.rds"))
```

## Plot

```{r}
#| label: plot-example
#| fig-cap: "Replace with your own figure."
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data = processed, mapping = aes(x = site, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

## Reuse a figure made by a script

Figures saved by `scripts/3_analyse.R` land in `outputs/`, which is ignored by
git. A site built by CI does not have them. Either re-create the figure in a
chunk as above, or commit the few small images you want to publish.
